guesses.spec_quote: Set status to zero. Issue no host commands.
guesses.decision: c_idle__start and c_idle__tick both copy k_position__x into c_idle__observed_x and set c_idle__status = 0 on every call; c_idle__cond is never set because the status is never nonzero and the component declares no conditions.
guesses.why: Done when is 'never' and no conditions are declared, so the only valid status is 0 (running). Refreshing observed_x in start as well keeps it valid before the first tick.

guesses.decision: The unit emits no log output; it only sets k_position__x = selfX in k_position__update.
guesses.why: Units must never PRINT; telemetry is generated by the driver from the Log field.
